title: Whole-Vehicle Impressions and System Mentions
summary: This topic mostly contains fragmented mentions of overall vehicle impressions, cabin craftsmanship, and system references, with only limited clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car as a whole, sustained comfort, and an elevated overall ownership or purchase experience.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize an unspecified system strongly and note that an issue persisted without resolution.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention the charging experience, premium feel, cabin or cockpit craftsmanship, display dust attraction, routing, volume behavior, and roof insulation without enough context for clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are too short or incomplete to determine sentiment reliably.
The topic mixes broad overall impressions with unrelated details such as charging, displays, routing, audio behavior, dealership experience, and roof insulation.
Several fragments lack enough context to identify which specific system or feature is being discussed.
